builds.howItPlays: You spend your early turns on Mobilize and Catalyst of Aeons, spells that give you extra runes, and on cheap answers like Flurry of Blades, a 1-cost spell that deals 1 damage to every unit on the battlefields. Once you can pay 9 for Dazzling Aurora, it plays the first unit from the top of your deck for free at the end of each of your turns, often Elder Dragon, a 12-cost unit whose damage kills any enemy unit it hits, and Miss Fortune lets one unit a turn move from one battlefield straight to the other.
builds.whyYou: You like games that start quiet and end with your opponent unable to keep up. You don't mind playing several turns with almost no units, holding removal and building up runes, as long as a big payoff is on the way. Some games Aurora won't show up in time, and you can live with that. You enjoy moving your big units between the two battlefields at the right moment to score points on both. If a free big unit landing every turn sounds better than racing, this Miss Fortune suits you.

builds.howItPlays: You fill both battlefields with cheap units like Treasure Hunter, a 2-cost unit that makes a Gold token (spend it later for an extra rune) each time it moves, while Miss Fortune lets one unit a turn move from one battlefield straight to the other and Miss Fortune, Buccaneer lets you play your units directly onto battlefields nobody controls. When your opponent fights back, you play Rengar, Trophy Hunter, a 5-cost unit with 6 Might and Ambush (you can play him as a reaction into a fight), even to a battlefield where only enemy units stand, and finish the fight with Punch First, which gives a unit +5 Might.
builds.whyYou: You like to get units down early and keep your opponent busy on both battlefields. You enjoy keeping runes open on their turn so a big unit can drop into a fight they thought they had won. You don't mind working out each turn which unit moves where, because that's how this deck finds the battlefield nobody is guarding. If surprise attacks sound more fun than waiting for one big turn, this Miss Fortune suits you.
